title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL LINES:METALLIC (1,800 affected)
summary: IN A COLLISION, BOLTS MAY DAMAGE OR PIERCE A FUEL LINE, CAUSING FUEL SPILLAGE. AFFECTED VEHICLES MAY NOT BE CAPABLE OF MEETING THE MINIMUM FUEL LEAKAGE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY".

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY (139 affected)
summary: FUEL TANKS ON VEHICLES MAY EXHIBIT FUEL LEAKAGE WHEN COMPLETELY FILLED BECAUSE THE LUGGAGE PARTITION ATTACHMENT SCREWS HAVE PENETRATED THE TOP OF THE TANK.

title: General Motors, LLC: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:FRAME AND PANEL (4,393 affected)
summary: THE INNER AND OUTER PANELS OF THE FIBERGLASS HOOD COULD SEPARATE DURING VEHICLE OPERATION.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:ATTACHMENTS (170 affected)
summary: SOME OF THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WITH IMPROPERLY WELDED FUEL TANK SUPPORT STRAPS. UNDER CERTAIN COLLISION CONDITIONS, THESE STRAPS MAY NOT BE ABLE TO SUPPORT THE FUEL TANK AND LEAKS COULD DEVELOP.

title: ROSS GEAR DIV.: STEERING:COLUMN COUPLING (1,208 affected)
summary: THE FIT OF THE STEERING SHAFT COUPLING ON THE STEERING GEAR SHAFT MAY NOT BE CORRECT. DUE TO OVERMACHINING IN THE BORE OF THE COUPLING, THE JOINT MAY BE LOOSE AND MAY LEAD TO ACCELERATED WEAR AND DETERIORATION IN PERFORMANCE.

title: PRESVAC SYS (BURL) LTD.: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR (87 affected)
summary: SPINDLE RADIUS IS SUBJECT TO CRACKING UNDER A LOAD GREATER THAN OR EQUAL TO THE RATED CAPACITY OF 22,500 LBS. IF A LARGE ENOUGH CRACK DEVELOPS, THE SPINDLE COULD COLLAPSE AND THE WHEEL ASSEMBLY COULD BREAK AWAY FROM THE AXLE.

title: Mazda North American Operations: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (232,373 affected)
summary: ANCHORAGE BOLT MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY REINSTALLED AFTER VEHICLE REPAIR. THE BOLT COULD LOOSEN DURING NORMAL VEHICLE OPERATION.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: WHEELS:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS (6 affected)
summary: THE ALUMINUM WHEELS ARE EQUIPPED WITH SHORT THREADED BOLTS WHICH WILL NOT PROPERLY SECURE A SPARE STEEL WHEEL. USE OF THIS SPARE COULD RESULT IN LOSS OF THE OUTER WHEEL WITHOUT WARNING.

title: COACHMEN INDUSTRIES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:BED(RV) (72 affected)
summary: SPRING IS NOT ADEQUATE TO SUPPORT THE WEIGHT OF THE BUNK WHICH IS INSTALLED ABOVE THE DRIVER/PASSENGER COMPARTMENT.

title: Ford Motor Company: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:INSTRUMENT L (626 affected)
summary: IN THE EVENT OF A SHORT CIRCUIT IN THE INSTRUMENT PANEL, THE HEADLAMP AND INTERIOR ILLUMINATION CONTROL SWITCHES COULD OVERHEAT.

title: COACHMEN INDUSTRIES, INC.: ENGINE COOLING SYSTEM:PUMP:WATER (8 affected)
summary: A PULLEY WAS INCORRECTLY ATTACHED TO THE WATER PUMP WHEN THE DASH AIR CONDITIONING WAS INSTALLED IN THE VEHICLE. THIS MAY CAUSE THE PULLY TO WOBBLE AND THE NUTS TO WORK LOOSE.

title: MITSUBISHI MANUFACTURING AMER: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (7,799 affected)
summary: SNAP PIN COULD INTERFERE WITH THE THROTTLE MECHANISM. IF THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL IS HEAVILY DEPRESSED, THE THROTTLE COULD BECOME STUCK IN THE OPEN POSITION. NORMALLY, WHEN ACCELERATOR PEDAL IS RELEASED, THROTTLE CLOSES AND VEHICLE SPEED DECREASES.
